name: findling/php-cs-fixer-tools
description: php-cs-fixer with nextcloud/coding-standard for the Findling companion app, CI and development only
_comment: This is a project of its own, like tools/psalm, and not part of php/composer.json on purpose: the style toolchain must not be resolved together with the exactly pinned phpunit/phpunit of the app, and nothing in php/tools reaches the store archive (scripts/release/store-archive.sh includes appinfo lib templates js css img l10n only).

All three versions are exact pins. php-cs-fixer/shim and kubawerlos/php-cs-fixer-custom-fixers are required by nextcloud/coding-standard. kubawerlos/php-cs-fixer-custom-fixers 3.37.5 and php-cs-fixer/shim 3.95.30 to 3.95.32 are left out on purpose: they were younger than the minimum age of 14 days when the pins were chosen.
platform.php is 8.2.27, the lower bound of the app, so the lock never pulls a version the PHP 8.2 runtime of the job php-cs cannot run.
All three packages were cleared by the owner before they were fetched, decision E-07 of 21.11.2026 in .planning/phases/44-php-sicherheits-gates/44-OWNER-DECISIONS.md.
